_comment: A lone block of 96 Spearmen (6 files of 16) facing west, doubled to 12 files of 8 by a plain explicatio (B, the half-file drill) and then folded back by N, which on a block whose files an explicatio dealt is that explicatio in reverse (Asclepiodotus 10.20: the men who changed their position go back to their original stations). Drill mode, no enemy. Each rear half-file falls back down its interval in column and steps in behind its own file once it is behind the file's rear man; the files then close on the middle while the front rank keeps its line at x 652.5. By tick 600 the explicatio has ended with the block at (684.03, 420.0); N at tick 660 deals the files back, and by tick 1260 the block stands at (720.68, 420.0), within a wu of where it stood before the B, its front at x 653.18 at tick 1320 (0.68 wu back). No two men come within a body radius (the nearest pair 6.85 wu). Measured 2026-11-13 on FULL dumps of the state ticks, the unit and soldier positions hash identically on seed runs 0 to 4 (no enemy, no roll). On main, N deals the files laterally and the block re-centres: the front walks back to x 612.21 and the block ends at (679.71, 420.08), so the front_rank_line and position expects fail there on every seed run. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
